description: Regression corpus of real-world URL shapes (synthetic values) for sign-in, password reset, payment, signed downloads, banking/government and similar flows, plus over-protection checks. For each mode, 'preserved' means: the engine returns the input unchanged AND navigation (DNR rules, via the simulator) leaves it unchanged; 'changed' means at least one of them modifies it. Entries marked 'changed' in experimental are accepted, documented risks (docs/architecture/overview.md) unless noted. Any change to an expectation must be deliberate and reviewed.

entries.note: Protection must not keep trackers in ordinary links; Clean/Strict are expected to clean these.
